title: Text-pathway representation and class-imbalance diagnostic

decision_rule.statement: Text is 'informative under some tested representation' if the best cell on rotation 0 beats the majority baseline by more than 0.02 accuracy and has positive macro-F1 gain in at least 5 of 7 rotations.

notes: PCA is fitted on training rows of each rotation only. pca8 reproduces the paper's text pathway. TF-IDF control is omitted because raw text is not shipped; add it via the adapter if the corpus is available locally.
